name: life-insurance-data-validation
description: 個人壽險年度填報資料品質與檢核助手

scripts.workbook: node tools/export-workbook.js > /tmp/wb.json && python3 tools/build_workbook.py /tmp/wb.json samples/excel/試用資料_含錯誤.xlsx && node tools/export-workbook.js --clean > /tmp/wb-clean.json && python3 tools/build_workbook.py /tmp/wb-clean.json samples/excel/試用資料_正確.xlsx && node tools/recalc-workbook.js samples/excel/試用資料_含錯誤.xlsx samples/excel/試用資料_正確.xlsx
scripts.workbook:large: node tools/export-workbook.js --seed 2026 --policies 1000 > /tmp/wbL.json && python3 tools/build_workbook.py /tmp/wbL.json samples/excel/試用資料_1000張_含錯誤.xlsx && node tools/export-workbook.js --clean --seed 2026 --policies 1000 > /tmp/wbLc.json && python3 tools/build_workbook.py /tmp/wbLc.json samples/excel/試用資料_1000張_正確.xlsx && node tools/recalc-workbook.js samples/excel/試用資料_1000張_含錯誤.xlsx samples/excel/試用資料_1000張_正確.xlsx
